description: This PHP source file defines the AuthController class for user authentication, login, logout, signup, password recovery, and OAuth integration within the Goteo project. It manages user sessions, redirects, and external OAuth providers.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: Controller class handling user authentication, session management, login, logout, signup, password recovery, and OAuth login/signup processes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller and sets the theme for views.

methods.name: redirectLoginAction
methods.description: Redirects to the login page with query parameters.

methods.name: checkSession
methods.description: Checks if user is logged in or needs to redirect to SSL.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Checks user credentials and manages login process.

methods.name: loginAction
methods.description: Handles login page display and login process.

methods.name: logoutAction
methods.description: Logs out the user, manages session destruction, and redirects.

methods.name: checkSignup
methods.description: Validates and processes user signup data.

methods.name: signupAction
methods.description: Displays signup form and processes registration.

methods.name: passwordRecoveryAction
methods.description: Handles password recovery via token or email request.

methods.name: passwordResetAction
methods.description: Allows logged-in users to reset their password.

methods.name: oauthAction
methods.description: Manages OAuth authentication with external providers.

methods.name: oauthSignupAction
methods.description: Handles user registration via OAuth providers.
